notes: §2002:13.9.3 GR3: a constant-name written in another entry is an integer literal of the constant's value, which for an arithmetic-expression is the 32-digit standard-arithmetic result truncated to its integer part (§2002:7.2.5.2 GR1, GR2; kb/Work PB5575). The witness's 01 W1 PIC 9(2) VALUE K3, K3 = 100 / 7 * 7, displays 99.
